payload.name: Reaper’s Shadow
description: A fragment of cloth or glass—its true nature is unclear—that seems to devour light. While attuned, bright light within 10 feet becomes dim light and dim light becomes nonmagical darkness. Once per day, as a bonus action, you may mark a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute: the first time it falls below half its hit points it takes 2d6 extra necrotic damage and cannot benefit from temporary hit points while the effect lasts. The effect requires concentration. When a creature dies within 15 feet, you gain advantage on your next attack roll or saving throw before the end of your next turn; if unused, you instead suffer disadvantage on your next Wisdom saving throw. Each use of the mark requires a DC 12 Wisdom save or imposes latent fatalism until your next long rest.
